articles.title: IPCC report delay will threaten global effort to tackle climate crisis, says top scientist

source.name: Fiona Harvey, Graham Readfearn and Damien Gayle in Antalya

articles.description: Johan Rockström, one of world’s leading climate experts, says slowing down scientific work puts cooperation at risk Climate science is “foundational” to the Paris agreement and worldwide progress on tackling global heating, and attempts to delay new scientific reports threaten global cooperation on tackling the crisis, one of the world’s leading climate scientists has warned.
